errors.observation: White oval painted field emblem is predicted as sports ball at confidence .282.
errors.hypothesis: Native masked-crop training lacks this background context and full-frame resizing changes scale.
errors.alternative: Insufficient negative examples of circular marks independently of input scale.
errors.control: Compare matched crop/full-frame preprocessing and add reviewed train-only logo negatives in a future dataset; keep validation groups separate.
errors.action: Do not promote to a raw-video ball detector.

errors.observation: More spectators are correct but steward recall drops on the same 14 val crops.
errors.hypothesis: New source/class distribution shifts the classifier boundaries; limited steward source diversity.
errors.alternative: Some role labels require context absent from the crop.
errors.control: Preserved-backbone/colour-scale experiments and R015 compatible-head interpolation, with all role cohorts reported.
errors.action: Keep R007 default; publish R015 as a measured alternative.

errors.observation: Replacing the generic-person supplier with F003 raises TeamTrack player FP from 48 to 76 and loses all four previously found selected steward proposals.
errors.hypothesis: Person fine-tuning on masked native crops does not transfer uniformly to other images.
errors.alternative: Proposal location/extent changes cause crop-classifier mismatch.
errors.control: Same R015 role weights, source images and inference settings, only generic-person weights changed.
errors.action: Reject replacement and retain pretrained generic-person proposals.

errors.observation: All 67 annotated balls on 14 full panoramas are missed at IoU .50, including at AP floor .001. F003 yields 16 FP at confidence .25; one at frame50300 is the painted letter dot (confidence .453).
errors.hypothesis: Global resize to 1280 removes tiny ball detail while native-crop training did not cover the same background/scale.
errors.alternative: Limited or imperfect AI annotation coverage, location mismatch and insufficient ball shape diversity.
errors.control: Human review; compare original, tiled and globally resized views of the same validation frames and matched training data, with fixed group splits.
errors.action: Keep full-frame ball profile experimental and publish all zero AP results. Do not hide difficult references or tune on a final test.
